_doc: A11 balance overlay on the DESIGN.md §9 tables, found with tools/sim_zones.js on the game engine (qa party_model). check_mons.js --write applies it; check_mons.js verifies src/data == DESIGN ⊕ this file. §9.13.1 (a lineage's s moves as one, each stage keeps its character): s = DESIGN s × lineages.<id> {hp, dmg} × global {hp, dmg}[midTier] × monsters.<id>.trim {hp, dmg} (0.8–1.25); dmg scales atk and mag together, def/mdef/agi stay DESIGN's. global stands in for the engine curve (R.Rules.K) against the standard party (see the request to rules). Fitted with sim_zones --refit (zone groups vs a strength-proportional target; projectStructured). encounters.<zone>: groups = base re-weighted per stage band by sim_zones --retilt (M2; M5 strength 3.0–3.4 kept; metal/solo/T8-set groups keep their share); base = the untilted groups (overlay only), including hand fixes for L6 / M5 / M1 named in why. monsters.<id>.desc and actions.<id>.<name|msg>: STYLE_JA fixes. Every entry carries a why.

global.why: sim_zones on the game engine (qa party_model): the engine curve (R.Rules.K) against the standard party needs monsters with more HP and less damage from T3 on; one factor per tier for every regular non-metal monster (index = midTier of its stage)
